question: A shopkeeper does a faulty weighing of an item of 930 gram instead of 1 kg and sells it at its cost price. Find his profit percentage on selling 15 kg of the item.
solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper sells 930 grams instead of 1000 grams

**Formula used:**

Gain = (S.P - C.P)

Gain % = (P × 100)/C.P

Where, C.P = cost price

S.P = selling price ; P = profit
